title: Flagship price statement
tables:
PLANNING PRICE
One-off engineering build: approximately ₹50-56 lakh, with an internal planning target of ~₹55 lakh. Proposed commercial flagship price: ₹89 lakh + GST, approximately ₹1.05 crore including 18% GST. These figures are preliminary, dated 03 September 2026, configuration-dependent and subject to supplier quotations, duties, redesign, validation scope, service package and commercial approval.
